body:
Our organizing efforts are more critical than ever, and we need your support.
# [](https://act.sarahmcbride.com/go/1269?t=1&akid=3993%2E21716%2Epg8juV)
There are just 3 weeks left until Election Day. That’s just 21 days to share Sarah’s positive message for the future with as many of our neighbors as possible!
**Right now our team of volunteers and organizers are working hard, knocking on doors and canvassing their communities.**
[****](https://act.sarahmcbride.com/go/1274?c0=mcb-em-20261014-1.nbrNnw&refcode=em20261014-3993&t=2&akid=3993%2E21716%2Epg8juV)
Their work is how we share Sarah’s vision for bold change, from affordable healthcare and housing to paid family and medical leave.
And we’re counting on grassroots supporters like you to help us fully fund our organizing in this final stretch! A donation from you can:
📲 **Help us text more voters** to remind them to vote for Sarah
☕️ **Buy a volunteer coffee or a snack** to keep them fueled on the ground
🪧 **Fund more yard signs** for lawns across the state

Montana is glad to welcome the President back to our great state! I am proud to have served under President Trump as his U.S. Attorney to Montana. Today he is coming back to Montana because he knows that the fight is not finished. In the final days of this campaign, with races across the country, President Trump chose Montana. That is not an accident. He knows what every conservative in America should know - this seat is the one that decides the Senate majority. If the Democrats flip this seat and Schumer takes back the Senate. President Trump’s winning agenda of a sealed southern border, tax cuts, conservative judges, American energy - hits a brick wall. Tonight is also our final pre-election fundraising deadline. This is the last number Schumer, the national press, and every donor in this country will see before Election Day. What we report tonight tells the nation whether Montana is up for grabs or not. When President Trump takes that stage in Kalispell today, he is sending a message to Chuck Schumer, to the liberal Super PAC that has spent over $7 million against me, and to every radical liberal donor trying to buy this seat: **Montana is not for sale. Let’s show the President that we’re in this to win this. President Trump and I are counting on you! Thank you, Kurt Alme Trump-Endorsed Candidate for Senate P.S. Friends, I have known Trina Swanson for over 10 years. We worked together in the federal government to keep our nation safe, and later founded a law firm together to help people facing unfair treatment in a broken system. We've got a bit of a problem.
Our final FEC deadline is **less than nine hours away** -- and right now, we're falling **dangerously short** of our critical $2,000,000 grassroots goal.
**The stakes are too high for working Kansans to fall short** _**this close to Election Day**_**.[Will you chip in anything you can spare now to help us reach this urgent goal -- to fund TV ads, campaign events and get-out-the-vote efforts in the final sprint before all ballots are cast?](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/3897e61b-fd5e-4f8b-ae49-263317f27e42?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**
We're raising the alarm today because after this deadline, our numbers are made public by the FEC. That means this is one of our final chances to show Sen. Marshall and his super PAC allies just how strong this grassroots movement is going into Election Day.
If we don't reach this critical goal, Sen. Marshall's allies will feel emboldened to spend millions more on false attack ads -- confident that they can easily drown out the voices of working Kansans. Worse, we won't have the resources we need to reach voters in these important final days or fight back against smear campaigns.
Here's the truth: Thanks to the commitment of grassroots supporters like you, this race is a toss-up. That means the results could go either way in November. **In races this tight, there 's one thing that differentiates a winner: resources. **
That's why we're reaching out _again_.
Unlike Sen. Marshall, our movement is powered by people, not corporate PACs and Washington insiders. But in order for us to compete with their war chest, we need a surge of grassroots support right now.
We're running out of time to reach our $2 million goal, so we're asking you to give whatever you can.**[Please help us reach our final FEC goal by 11:59 p.m. tonight. A contribution made today can make a massive difference in a race this tight.](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/3897e61b-fd5e-4f8b-ae49-263317f27e42?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**
[Donate](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/3897e61b-fd5e-4f8b-ae49-263317f27e42?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Together, let's win this and bring Kansas values to Washington.
In gratitude,
Team Hamilton

**NEW INTERNAL POLL SHOWS THAT RACE FOR OH-01 IN PURE TOSS-UP** _**OH-01 is tied, with only 1.6% separating Conroy and Crooked Greg Landsman**_

---
| |

**Cincinnati, OH** — A new poll conducted by Torchlight Strategies and commissioned by Conroy for Congress was fielded from September 29 - October 2, 2026. The internal poll shows that Greg Landsman narrowly leads Eric Conroy 45.8% to 44.2%, with a third-party candidate at 5.4% and undecided voters at 4.6%.
On the generic ballot, the election is exactly tied at 45.3%, with 9.5% undecided - nearly unheard of in this national environment. Conroy is running just behind this party, meaning he still has GOP votes to bring home. On Landsman, when asked, more than half of voters (52.5%) could not name anything they like about Landsman. Beyond the base voters who like the D next to his name, Landsman has little to no brand of his own.
This polling comes in a tough national environment, with GOP committees and outside groups focused on incumbent protection. Despite the national environment, OH-01 looks poised to come down to the wire. With races in both the House and Senate tightening, this district clearly favors Conroy and statewide Republicans. Additionally, the poll follows a $1,000,000 investment disclosure by the super PAC that backed Conroy in the primary to promote his candidacy, a clear sign that Eric Conroy has the support needed to flip the seat for Republicans.
“Conroy has the momentum behind him and the ability to flip this seat. Greg Landsman is a crook, and even Democrats aren’t thrilled with his candidacy. National Republicans, from Vice President JD Vance, to House leadership, have come to the district to help campaign for Conroy. The investments made by the campaign and a supportive super PAC show that the Conroy campaign is still well positioned to flip this seat.” - Collin Wojcik, Campaign Manager, Conroy for Congress
**Press Contact:** Collin Wojcik, Campaign Manager [Press@EricConroy.com](mailto:Press@EricConroy.com)

Peter, This is a longer email than usual. But I believe it’s essential to keep you fully briefed on where things stand for the fair maps movement, and how we must keep moving this work forward. Thank you for everything you’ve already done to defend democracy. By the time you finish reading this message, I hope you’ll see how you’ve helped make a difference, and why a [**contribution from you today would make a critical impact,**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/141421720/653494596/1548394306?refcode=don_ndrc_tier1_email_BizPathForward_email_20261014-NDRC-Tier1-BizPathForward_&utm_source=email&utm_medium=email&utm_term=don&utm_content=20261014-NDRC-Tier1-BizPathForward_&utm_campaign=BizPathForward&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxMy8xLzg5Mjk0IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjgzMGZjY2Y0LTA0YzgtZjExMS1iZjViLTAwMGQzYTRmYmU4MyIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=RODFBXXYGTdzLmeei1OJQ2U6K1sOU9Lx7Rg0kymriSI=) especially now that we’re in the final few weeks of the midterm elections. **Where Republicans WANTED us to be right now:** When Donald Trump and his Republican allies launched the mid-decade gerrymandering crisis, people like Steve Bannon bragged that they could steal as many as 21 congressional seats. They thought they could guarantee another two years of a Republican House majority before a single vote was cast. **Where things ACTUALLY stand right now:** That scheme failed because the American people refused to let them steal power. The fair maps movement fought back on front after front, with folks like you speaking out and pitching in whenever possible to help stop new gerrymanders. Thank you for never backing down. Ultimately, the GOP only manipulated enough maps to give themselves an edge of about two to three seats... maybe? — a far cry from their hopes and dreams, and not nearly enough to withstand an electorate unhappy with their agenda. So I’ll be blunt: Democrats are going to take back the House in November. **But then the next fight will just be getting started:** The lesson Republicans are learning from this isn’t that they should have better policies. It’s that they didn’t cheat hard enough. As soon as the polls close on November 3rd, we expect Republicans to double down on their efforts to gerrymander more maps for 2028. Over a third of all states tried to draw new congressional maps in the past two years. Even more states could join the fray in the next two years. The outcomes of those fights will depend in large part on what happens up and down the ballot in the next few weeks. Some of the most critical elections are getting much, much less attention than the battle for Congress — but they are getting plenty of big money from national Republicans and their billionaire backers. Electing more Democracy Defenders to key state-level offices this November will make it a lot easier to win more fights for fair elections in the months ahead. State legislators, governors, judges, and other officials who believe in fair maps and fair representation can be a firewall against new gerrymanders and voter suppression. [**We’ve endorsed over 300 of these Democracy Defenders in the November elections, and we’re counting on grassroots support to help put them over the top.**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/141421721/653494597/1548394306?refcode=don_ndrc_tier1_email_BizPathForward_email_20261014-NDRC-Tier1-BizPathForward_&utm_source=email&utm_medium=email&utm_term=don&utm_content=20261014-NDRC-Tier1-BizPathForward_&utm_campaign=BizPathForward&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxMy8xLzg5Mjk0IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjgzMGZjY2Y0LTA0YzgtZjExMS1iZjViLTAwMGQzYTRmYmU4MyIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=RODFBXXYGTdzLmeei1OJQ2U6K1sOU9Lx7Rg0kymriSI=) But look: having endless cycles of mid-decade redistricting is no way to run a country. This process is supposed to happen once a decade — just to make sure every community gets represented equally. Not to give one party an unfair advantage whenever they think they need it. **How we stop this endless, unsustainable game of whack-a-mole:** Plain and simple, we must enact a federal ban on partisan gerrymandering and mid-decade redistricting. And we need to get it done before the 2030 Census. If not, the next post-census redistricting cycle could be catastrophic for equal representation, thanks to the Supreme Court ripping away the Voting Rights Act’s guardrails against discriminatory maps. **So for the next few weeks, the most important thing any of us can do is help elect more state-level Democracy Defenders who can prevent more short-term damage while building power that lets us ultimately pass nationwide reform that shores up democracy for the long haul.** [**The future of this work depends on the victories we can deliver on November 3rd. We’re still working to allocate more resources to more targeted races in the next few weeks, and every donation we receive to this email will help make sure we can go as big as we need to. Please make a contribution today.**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/141421722/653494598/1548394306?refcode=don_ndrc_tier1_email_BizPathForward_email_20261014-NDRC-Tier1-BizPathForward_&utm_source=email&utm_medium=email&utm_term=don&utm_content=20261014-NDRC-Tier1-BizPathForward_&utm_campaign=BizPathForward&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxMy8xLzg5Mjk0IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjgzMGZjY2Y0LTA0YzgtZjExMS1iZjViLTAwMGQzYTRmYmU4MyIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=RODFBXXYGTdzLmeei1OJQ2U6K1sOU9Lx7Rg0kymriSI=) | _If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately:_

clean_body: This is a longer email than usual, but I believe it’s essential to keep you fully briefed on where things stand, and how we must keep moving this work forward. | Peter, This is a longer email than usual. But I believe it’s essential to keep you fully briefed on where things stand for the fair maps movement, and how we must keep moving this work forward. Thank you for everything you’ve already done to defend democracy. By the time you finish reading this message, I hope you’ll see how you’ve helped make a difference, and why a = especially now that we’re in the final few weeks of the midterm elections. Where Republicans WANTED us to be right now: When Donald Trump and his Republican allies launched the mid-decade gerrymandering crisis, people like Steve Bannon bragged that they could steal as many as 21 congressional seats. They thought they could guarantee another two years of a Republican House majority before a single vote was cast. Where things ACTUALLY stand right now: That scheme failed because the American people refused to let them steal power. The fair maps movement fought back on front after front, with folks like you speaking out and pitching in whenever possible to help stop new gerrymanders. Thank you for never backing down. Ultimately, the GOP only manipulated enough maps to give themselves an edge of about two to three seats... maybe? — a far cry from their hopes and dreams, and not nearly enough to withstand an electorate unhappy with their agenda. So I’ll be blunt: Democrats are going to take back the House in November. But then the next fight will just be getting started: The lesson Republicans are learning from this isn’t that they should have better policies. It’s that they didn’t cheat hard enough. As soon as the polls close on November 3rd, we expect Republicans to double down on their efforts to gerrymander more maps for 2028. Over a third of all states tried to draw new congressional maps in the past two years. Even more states could join the fray in the next two years. The outcomes of those fights will depend in large part on what happens up and down the ballot in the next few weeks. Some of the most critical elections are getting much, much less attention than the battle for Congress — but they are getting plenty of big money from national Republicans and their billionaire backers. Electing more Democracy Defenders to key state-level offices this November will make it a lot easier to win more fights for fair elections in the months ahead. State legislators, governors, judges, and other officials who believe in fair maps and fair representation can be a firewall against new gerrymanders and voter suppression. = But look: having endless cycles of mid-decade redistricting is no way to run a country. This process is supposed to happen once a decade — just to make sure every community gets represented equally. Not to give one party an unfair advantage whenever they think they need it. How we stop this endless, unsustainable game of whack-a-mole: Plain and simple, we must enact a federal ban on partisan gerrymandering and mid-decade redistricting. And we need to get it done before the 2030 Census. If not, the next post-census redistricting cycle could be catastrophic for equal representation, thanks to the Supreme Court ripping away the Voting Rights Act’s guardrails against discriminatory maps. So for the next few weeks, the most important thing any of us can do is help elect more state-level Democracy Defenders who can prevent more short-term damage while building power that lets us ultimately pass nationwide reform that shores up democracy for the long haul. = | If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately: = | = = | = = | = Thanks for reading — and thanks for staying engaged in the fight for free and fair elections. As you can see, that dedication is paying off. Hi Pro-Life Friend,

As election day nears, James Talarico is letting his "moderate" mask slip.

When asked at a recent campaign event who his favorite drag queen was, he didn't miss a beat - instantly rattling "their" name off like he'd been asked his favorite color.

That video has gone viral online, racking up millions of views on social media.

Talarico has spent this entire campaign trying to sell Texas voters on a moderate, Bible-quoting version of himself, and videos like this are the LAST thing Talarico's campaign wants getting out to Texas voters.

Texas voters outside Austin won't buy his facade, not once they see the real Talarico instead of the campaign-trail version.

And right now in Michigan, Democrat U.S. Senate candidate Abdul El-Sayed is running the same playbook, holding town halls in Lansing, Grand Rapids, Detroit, Flint, and Macomb, hoping moderate suburban voters forget he wants abortion legal through all nine months.

My name is Kristan Hawkins, and I'm the President of Students for Life Action. You can think of us as the grassroots arm of the Pro-Life Movement.

Dear Pro-Life Friend, here's my problem.

You and I can't rely on the national media to tell the truth about these politicians' abortion extremism.

So it's up to grassroots folks like you and me to hold them accountable.
That's exactly what I want to do with my rapid response counter-protests at as many candidate events as possible in our targeted races.

body:
The midterms are almost here, and I need every dadgum patriot who can spare a few bucks to step up and help us keep the House RED.

| [](https://trk.email.tim-burchett.-mnlmqLuPUibwvGmoSvQ)

I'll tell you what keeps me up at night, Peter.
If Democrats take back the House this November, I reckon they'll waste no time going after President Trump.
[Another impeachment circus. Another witch hunt. Another two years of liberals running their mouths instead of doing their dadgum jobs.](https://trk.email.tim-burchett.)
And that's just the beginning.
[Open borders. Defunding our police. Gutting our military. Abortion on demand.](https://trk.email.tim-burchett._TtrhVrZqew)
We've already seen enough of that mess for one lifetime.
I'm not interested in going backward. I'm interested in securing our border, standing behind our men and women in uniform, protecting our kids, and keeping Washington's grubby hands out of our lives.
[But Democrats only need to flip a handful of seats to take back the House.](https://trk.email.tim-burchett._J_pKxDisnLuXFpQ)
And if they do, I believe they'll make impeaching President Trump and ending the America First movement their number one priority.
Well, dadgummit, I'm not about to sit around twiddling my thumbs while that happens.
[Peter that's why I'm humbly asking you to chip in $10, $25, or whatever you can spare today to help me keep the House in Republican hands and stop another two years of Democrat-led nonsense.](https://trk.email.tim-burchett._vMBLfis8qhyiwQ)

| [CHIP IN NOW](https://trk.email.tim-burchett._VZQZuBcUW6j01ivQuJUg)

name: Chris Pappas
subject: This journey
body:
[ https://act.chrispappas.org/go/126?t=1001&akid=9537%2E582294%2ETm7oaH ]Chris Pappas for Senate[ https://act.chrispappas.org/go/126?t=1002&akid=9537%2E582294%2ETm7oaH ]Chris Pappas for Senate

It’s Chris.

It's been an incredible journey since we launched our campaign 18 months
ago — and tonight represents one of the biggest moments in our fight to
keep New Hampshire blue.

[ https://act.chrispappas.org/go/181?c0=em_ms_cp_20261014_4.0CgNm8&refcode=em20261014-4&t=1003&akid=9537%2E582294%2ETm7oaH ]If you’re already on board and ready to help us reach our final FEC
fundraising goal at midnight tonight, can I count on you to rush a
$5 contribution before the deadline?

Our final Federal Election Commission deadline is tonight at midnight.

This is our final public fundraising report before Election Day.

It’s the final time our fundraising numbers will be published publicly —
for everyone from the media to John Sununu and Donald Trump to see the
strength of our campaign.

[ https://act.chrispappas.org/go/181?c0=em_ms_cp_20261014_4.0CgNm8&refcode=em20261014-4&t=1004&akid=9537%2E582294%2ETm7oaH ]Tonight is our chance to show what we’ve built together — a movement of
people who believe in a freer, fairer future. We set a goal to raise
$350,000 before tonight’s deadline. Can you chip in $5
before midnight?

The GOP and the MAGA billionaires backing them are determined to elect
John Sununu and flip this seat red. That’s why they are spending over $60
million to try and buy this seat – and they’re counting on us falling
short tonight.

With Election Day in less than three weeks, every single day matters. And
every dollar has to stretch even further in these final moments.

That’s why I’m reaching out one last time to ask for your support. Not
because it’s a nice-to-have, but because hitting this $350,000 goal
tonight is the only way we’ll be able to win this race.

[ https://act.chrispappas.org/go/181?c0=em_ms_cp_20261014_4.0CgNm8&refcode=em20261014-4&t=1005&akid=9537%2E582294%2ETm7oaH ]Please, will you chip in
anything you can before our final FEC deadline at MIDNIGHT to help us
reach our $350,000 fundraising goal and keep us on track to win on
November 3rd?

[ https://act.chrispappas.org/go/181?c0=em_ms_cp_20261014_4.0CgNm8&amount=5&refcode=em20261014-4&t=1024&akid=9537%2E582294%2ETm7oaH ]Donate $5 »

Thank you,

Chris Pappas

| | | |

In just a few days, Americans go to the polls, and we keep hearing the same thing from good conservatives: "My vote doesn't matter." "I'm staying home this year to send the GOP a message." We understand the anger. Republican leadership squandered the majority we gave them – AGAIN. John Thune and the establishment had the votes and the mandate, and they spent it protecting the filibuster, cutting deals with Democrats, and passing the same bloated spending bills conservatives warned them about. But I have to be blunt, because the stakes are too high not to be: **Staying home doesn't send the message you think it does.** After a lost election, the only lesson the party bosses will learn is "be more liberal." Every conservative who sits this one out makes the next Republican Party weaker, softer, and MORE establishment – not less. **The RINOs aren't afraid of you staying home. They're counting on it. What they're afraid of is you showing up and electing conservatives they can't control.** Right now, we have fighters in the battle of their lives – in RED states – and a real chance to go on offense. We cannot abandon them now: **KEN PAXTON (TX):** Ken took on the establishment and beat John Cornyn in the primary. Now the polls show a tied race -- in TEXAS. Democrats and their allies are pouring money in to flip this seat, and if Texas falls, the Senate falls with it. **ROGER MARSHALL (KS):** Kansas hasn't sent a Democrat to the Senate since the 1930s. Today, this race is a dead heat. If we lose Kansas, there's no such thing as a safe seat anymore. **MIKE COLLINS (GA):** Mike is a fighter who won a tough primary and runoff to take on Jon Ossoff, one of Chuck Schumer's most reliable rubber stamps. This is our best chance to flip a seat for conservatives. And the fight doesn't stop at the Senate. In the House, we're backing proven fighters like Scott Perry, Joe Mitchell, Nick Begich, Eli Crane, Anna Paulina Luna, and Alex Mealer – conservatives who will hold the line when leadership tries to cave. These races will be decided by a few thousand votes. Your vote and the votes of the friends you bring with you could be the difference. **The future of the Republican Party is conservative. The only thing standing in the way is a shrinking group of establishment holdouts clinging to the past, and every conservative we elect pushes them closer to the exit.** The answer to weak Republicans isn't fewer conservatives in Congress. It's MORE. Every fighter we elect is one more vote leadership can't take for granted and one more reason the GOP establishment can't cut the next backroom deal. **[It's crunch time. Will you chip in $25, $50, or $100 right now to help get these conservatives over the finish line?](http://links.conservativesdefendingfreedom.com/u/click?_t=91d01aa68bbe4105984439520ca0f0af&_m=1302bdb1f770410fb3b92af76d48aff9&_e=j0wf72VqTaREWZnLdhxacxZqDA7U9-YgXlXBBJOhBB635lANImH67PKJJQ0aSE34PXr1-hNCpsDMymyppziLOb3Iayzqsij2E0sLD99_23OuCK1v5owVpSEid49oePNJCARh54msDQ5Y93XWyi6zwgxDlqdSKaHhqpNMQGUFJq4_AO5IEBj5CJcXI2TV1rZopP9o95fHRq0Nk7KpcEjCJIK-oNIQKYaderExR49d2ZlPLDFVpmkEaU_rUVgKrhhvNYm9aWQnxe2l96_pGxaYIiZiDSWtJy_Tu7UV0cBcfRVOcg23VszqoyEqarkuUdQ6wGZ6g0aamxM8FT-EFJ7G59gCu_0HkZd4q5eW5heXCcKw15U8tbk56JAgFHGsTqzGiJnYxUToU0AhD4dYA6bk1w%3D%3D)** Please contribute directly to multiple candidates with a single transaction. It's the easiest and most effective way to help them win. Then do two more things: **1\. VOTE.**

**2\. Forward this email to three conservative friends who might be thinking about staying home.** Let's make sure the message RINOs in Washington hear on November 3rd is the right one.

**[10 DAYS TO GO!](https://substack.com/redirect/06cd821d-e920-4eca-bedf-c85a276b139f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**
In just **10 days** , we're gathering in historic Germantown, Philadelphia, for our **2nd Annual F3 Forum: Faith • Family • Future of Education in America.**
_**Can Philadelphia become America 's next Mississippi Miracle?**_
Mississippi has demonstrated that meaningful improvements in education are possible. Now we're bringing together parents, educators, pastors, and community leaders to explore what worked, what Philadelphia can learn, and how each of us can help create the conditions for success.
**And we 've added something extraordinary!**
* **Saturday, October 24 | 9 a.m. -2 p.m.**
* **Braid Mills, 441 E. High Street, Philadelphia PA 19144**
Caribbean fusion lunch included.

Following the Forum, attendees will have an opportunity to tour a historic Underground Railroad site in Germantown - an experience connecting our nation's struggle for freedom with our responsibility to prepare the next generation for the future.
**Very limited tour spaces are available.**
Tickets start at **$35**. **Pastors, teachers, and Germantown residents attend free.** Everyone must register, and seating is limited.
👉 **[Reserve your seat today](https://substack.com/redirect/06cd821d-e920-4eca-bedf-c85a276b139f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).**
The future of America will not be determined in Washington, D.C. It will be determined in our homes, in our schools, and in our communities.
Blessings,
Kathy B.

Anyone who’s played or watched knows this: The fourth quarter feels different. Everyone on the field is nervous. And anyone who’s watched a lot of football knows what happens to teams who start acting like it’s over. Feeling anxious is normal. The players who win aren’t the ones who feel nothing. They’re the ones who take a breath, trust the team, and focus on the next play. The other side has more money and a bigger ad budget. That’s their depth chart. Our depth chart is a lot of people, all over this country, doing a little bit at a time. That’s how you win a close one. Help fuel Dave's fight for VA-10!
| | | | Hi Friend,
Suhas Subramanyam has never been about the people of Virginia’s 10th District. He has been about his party and his political career. VA-10 deserves a congressman who works for the people of our district, and **you can help me replace him, starting tonight.**
**Our final FEC report before Election Day closes at midnight.** It’s the last snapshot donors, voters, and the press will see before November 3, and a strong number tells everyone that Suhas can be beaten.
_Every dollar you give tonight helps me reach the voters who need to hear this message and see the proof that Suhas' loyalty has been to the Democratic party since day 1._
---
[DONATE TO A CONGRESSMAN WHO WILL ANSWER TO YOU](https://link.mail.beckwithforcongress._iRg/s3v25750b49)
_Let's check the receipts._
Suhas vowed to “help keep the federal government open to avoid shutdowns that impact federal government employees.”
Then, he voted 7 times to either shut the government down or keep it closed.
Suhas said he “supports preventing Members of Congress from trading individual stocks and will be a strong advocate for preventing corruption” in politics.
Then, he voted NO on the Stop Insider Trading Act, and he has accepted donations through a donation platform that has been under federal investigation since 2023.
Suhas said he will “combat political gerrymandering so that voters choose who represents them, not the other way around.”
Then, he spent months actively campaigning to pass the illegal referendum to redraw Virginia's congressional map to give Democrats 4 more seats. When it was overturned, he supported the General Assembly’s agenda to pack the Virginia Supreme Court.
Suhas said he will protect our nation against extremists working to erode American democracy.
Then, he voted against a House resolution condemning the DSA agenda, and he publicly accepts the DSA as part of his party saying their platform is "not a change in ideology."
Suhas claimed to have personally warned then-Congresswoman Barbara Comstock about the consequences of data centers 10 years ago.
Then, what did he do with all that foresight? _He built a political career._
Suhas' voting record is a proven pattern. Every time his party asks him to choose between the people of VA-10 and his party, he chooses his party.
He is a career politician who has held three offices in six years, and is not going to leave Congress on his own. The voters have to do it, and winning takes resources.
Tonight is the last chance to show on the record that this campaign has the support to get it done.
**I’m running for one reason: to represent the people of this district above all else.**
**Please chip in before midnight tonight** and help me take this seat back for you, for your neighbor, for your kid's future, and for the future of our district.
[HELP ME UNSEAT SUHAS BY MIDNIGHT TONIGHT](https://link.mail.beckwithforcongress._iRg/s2h03194acc)
| | | Thank you for standing with me.
God bless, Dave Beckwith
**Beckwith for Congress** _Restoring Faith in the American Dream_

_PS - The books close at midnight. Every dollar tonight moves us closer to unseating Suhas, a career politician whose only loyalty is to his party. Chip in now._

SEES

BY RMV EDITORIAL BOARD, ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE
[https://link.email.rockymountainvoice._ioA/s2i548eab8d

[https://link.email.rockymountainvoice._ioA/sdhabbf7413

Seven judges are on every Colorado ballot this fall, and not one of
them has an opponent.

Voters get a single question on each. Retain the judge, or don’t.
One is a Colorado Supreme Court justice and six sit on the Colorado
Court of Appeals, and every voter in the state sees all seven
regardless of county.

The State Commission on Judicial Performance reviewed all seven and
recommended keeping every one.

RMV reviewed every retention cycle in the state’s evaluation records
going back to 1990, and across 121 appellate candidacies in 36 years,
no Colorado Supreme Court justice or Court of Appeals judge has ever
drawn an unfavorable recommendation.

The material behind those recommendations is public. Most of it sits a
click or two past the page voters actually see.

READ MORE
[https://link.email.rockymountainvoice._ioA/sei82f506b5

HOUSE DISTRICT 5 TAUGHT ME WHAT $100 IS REALLY WORTH
[https://link.email.rockymountainvoice._ioA/s2h78d43a8b

BY JOHNNIE W. JOHNSON, ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE
[https://link.email.rockymountainvoice._ioA/s1uf09e251a

_A Denver GOP candidate running in a tough district reflects on how a
small, unexpected campaign contribution underscores the grassroots
fight for representation._

*
A MODEST BUT MEANINGFUL BOOST: Johnnie W. Johnson, the Republican
candidate in House District 5, received an unexpected $100
contribution from Denver GOP Vice Chair Tom Riggs, bringing his total
campaign funds to roughly $755, most of it from his own pocket and a
handful of small individual donors.

*
A DISTRICT WITH REAL POTENTIAL DESPITE THE ODDS: Johnson notes he
received about 8,000 votes in his 2024 run as a Republican in central
Denver, arguing it shows real appetite among voters for an
alternative, even as campaign funding remains scarce.

*
A PROMISE ROOTED IN RESPONSIVENESS: Drawing on a past experience where
an elected official never returned his call, Johnson, who leads a
Denver nonprofit for blind and disabled artists, pledges to return
every constituent’s call regardless of party affiliation.

Peter,This morning I got on a call with our whole team, and before I could get through my notes, I said: **["Holy shit. We could actually win this."](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/141424736/653504201/135284428?refcode=261014&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNjIvMS8xMjEwMzAiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiOWZjMTEwYTAtMGNjOC1mMTExLWJmNWItMDAwZDNhNGZiZTgzIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=PM82oRIYxXlN73IqdZRBu_dAkMoexlOOFi376y-epT4=)****This is what I’ve been hearing on the road: Republicans and independents are walking up to me and telling me they’re voting for a Democrat because they’re tired of the games being played in Washington.** And they aren’t keeping it to themselves. They’re saying it to their neighbors, at the hardware store, and online, with their names on it. Some of these folks have never voted for a Democrat in their lives.When I ask them why, I hear the same thing again and again. They want someone who is dependable and accountable. They want someone who answers to the Northwoods, not to party bosses or out-of-state money. But I’ll be honest with you. Those conversations only matter if they turn into votes, and we have three weeks to make that happen. My opponent has deep-pocketed allies who will flood the airwaves in these final weeks. We need the resources to make sure every voter in this district, including every Republican and independent who’s open to us, hears our message before they fill out their ballot. **[Will you chip in $7 today to help us finish the job?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/141424737/653504202/135284428?refcode=261014&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNjIvMS8xMjEwMzAiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiOWZjMTEwYTAtMGNjOC1mMTExLWJmNWItMDAwZDNhNGZiZTgzIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=PM82oRIYxXlN73IqdZRBu_dAkMoexlOOFi376y-epT4=)**A year ago, plenty of people said this seat wasn’t winnable. _You're getting this message because you’ve supported good causes and Democratic candidates. We need your support to continue fighting for our democracy. We love having you in our network, but if you only want our most important email updates,[click here.](https://act.blueampaction.com/go/108?t=2&akid=3498%2E259176%2EfNJHIw) If you'd like to unsubscribe, [click here.](https://act.blueampaction.com/go/109?t=3&akid=3498%2E259176%2EfNJHIw)_

Peter, here’s the deal.

Susan Collins really knows how to put on a show in the Senate.

She votes with Trump 96% of the time. If she knows one of his bad bills is going to tank, she’ll vote against it. If she’s the deciding vote, she’ll always vote for it, just like how she was the deciding vote for Brett Kavanaugh, who then overturned _Roe v. Wade._

The same is also true with Trump’s tariffs. Mainers and folks across the country are hurting badly from rising costs – and too many families are having to pick between picking up their prescriptions or putting food on the table.

So when she said during our debate that she brought down the cost of road salt, **I had to say what shouldn’t need to be said:** [](https://act.blueampaction.com/go/17985?amp%3Brefcode=&t=4&akid=3498%2E259176%2EfNJHIw) It goes to show just how out of touch Susan is with families across Maine. Road salt isn’t going to make groceries, heating oil, or everyday necessities affordable again.

Susan Collins is so used to putting the needs of billionaires over her constituents. I’m running to defeat her because folks across Maine have made me into the public servant I am today, and they deserve a Senator who isn’t afraid to take on tough battles.

**But poll after poll shows me tied with Susan Collins, and she’s spending double what we are on TV ads. We need to pick up the pace if we want any shot at flipping this seat and retaking the Senate majority for Democrats.** [ So Peter, will you please split $26 – or more, if you can spare it – between my campaign and Blue Amp Action right now? I refuse to take a dime from corporate PACs (unlike Susan), so I can’t run my campaign without folks like you chipping in.](https://act.blueampaction.com/go/18637?refcode=&t=5&akid=3498%2E259176%2EfNJHIw) _If you've saved payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through as soon as you click an amount and will be split evenly between Troy Jackson and Blue Amp Action_ | [DONATE $12 >>](https://act.blueampaction.com/go/17980?amp%3Brefcode=&t=6&akid=3498%2E259176%2EfNJHIw)

Hi team,
Tonight is our **very last FEC deadline** before the election.
**I 'll explain why this is such a big deal in a second, but the TLDR is:** Dan Meuser is the worst, we deserve real representation, we can win but we need the resources **[so please chip in.](https://substack.com/redirect/e00de3c0-23e2-4cc6-a5a4-671f7514be25?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**

When I first launched this campaign, a lot of people thought I was crazy. I can't say I blame them.
I'm running a grassroots campaign against one of the richest members of Congress in a district that has been written off by the national Democratic Party, meaning I'm doing it with no outside help.
But when I saw Dan Meuser vote to kick 30,000 people here off their health care, I couldn't sit back and do nothing. **And every single day since, you 've helped us prove that I wasn't so crazy after all.**
Our part of PA is fed up with do-nothing Dan getting rich while we get screwed. The numbers are trending in our favor and the voters are fired up. We can win this and make real change, but we need the resources to finish the job.
**Tonight 's deadline is the final big benchmark in our budget, and it's the last chance for us to prove that we can take on Dan's billionaire-funded war chest. It's a really critical moment for our campaign.**
**[Will you chip in before midnight to help us hit our final FEC goal and flip this seat?](https://substack.com/redirect/e00de3c0-23e2-4cc6-a5a4-671f7514be25?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**

Thank you for being a part of this team. I couldn't do this without you.
- Rachel Wallace

clean_body: A lot of people thought I was crazy | | ---|---|--- | | | Forwarded this email? ? for more A lot of people thought I was crazy Oct 14 | | | | | | | | | | | | | ---|---|--- Hi team, Tonight is our very last FEC deadline before the election. I 'll explain why this is such a big deal in a second, but the TLDR is: Dan Meuser is the worst, we deserve real representation, we can win but we need the resources When I first launched this campaign, a lot of people thought I was crazy. I can't say I blame them. I'm running a grassroots campaign against one of the richest members of Congress in a district that has been written off by the national Democratic Party, meaning I'm doing it with no outside help. But when I saw Dan Meuser vote to kick 30,000 people here off their health care, I couldn't sit back and do nothing. And every single day since, you 've helped us prove that I wasn't so crazy after all. Our part of PA is fed up with do-nothing Dan getting rich while we get screwed. The numbers are trending in our favor and the voters are fired up. We can win this and make real change, but we need the resources to finish the job. Tonight 's deadline is the final big benchmark in our budget, and it's the last chance for us to prove that we can take on Dan's billionaire-funded war chest. It's a really critical moment for our campaign. Thank you for being a part of this team. I couldn't do this without you. - Rachel Wallace Thanks for reading! ---
| | **FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE**
**October 13, 2026** **WESTFIELD, IN** - Legal counsel for Congresswoman **Victoria Spartz** has sent additional cease-and-desist letters to **J.D. Ford** ’s campaign and the Commonsense Hoosiers PAC, demanding they stop distributing falsified, AI-generated political advertisements that violate Indiana election law. **Ford** ’s latest ad, “The Heist,” uses fabricated AI images to depict **Spartz** committing crimes she never committed. A separate PAC mailer uses AI-generated imagery to advance false stock-trading allegations. Neither advertisement includes the disclaimer required under Indiana law. “Political campaigns should be about facts and records, not fabricated AI images and lies,” said **Spartz**. “My opponent voted for this law but now acts as if it only applies to others. He and his supporting super PACs have spent millions spreading false allegations and fabricating things I have never done. No campaign or billionaire-funded PAC should be above the law.” The cease-and-desist letters are available [here](https://us.list-manage.com/yfo13QCqwx3?e=57d5bacdc3&c2id=48548678578492b4098443901aa9dd52) and [here](https://us.list-manage.com/hzrSx__jVfC?e=57d5bacdc3&c2id=48548678578492b4098443901aa9dd52).

raided Ilhan Omar’s house in a highly unusual move that is being widely
condemned as a dangerous and authoritarian attack on a political
opponent.

We have been warning that Trump has been targeting Ilhan since he first
got back into office, calling her “garbage,” targeting her district with
ICE, and constantly making racist attacks on her and all
Somali-Americans.

Trump’s administration then claimed to be conducting an investigation
into Ilhan’s immigration status, a claim they’ve made for months now,
but this is a serious escalation by this fascist government.

We all know that Ilhan Omar is a proud American citizen who came to this
country legally as a young refugee. But this raid did not happen because
of Ilhan’s immigration paperwork.

Make no mistake — this raid happened just weeks before the midterm
elections in an attempt to intimidate, silence, and punish Ilhan Omar
and our entire progressive movement that seeks to take power back from
Trump and MAGA on November 3rd.

We have an obligation to fight back against this ludicrous, partisan
investigation, and show that we will not let Trump’s abuse of power go
unchecked. We have to organize for a massive progressive victory at the
ballot box so we can take back Congress from the MAGA far-right.

So, Peter, our
average donation is usually around $25. Many give less. Some give more.

DEIR AL-BALAH, Gaza Strip--At midnight, inside a tent in Deir al-Balah, Nour Abo Shamala put her head against the pillow with a plastic cup of salt water beside her. Sleep didn't come. A bolt of pain ran from her front tooth to the top of her skull and across her head. The only sounds in the night were the wind outside and her groans. She felt around for the plastic cup in the darkness and rinsed her mouth with the water. It brought no relief to the ache in her upper jaw. She soaked a rag in cold water, pressed it against her mouth, and waited for dawn.
Abo Shamala, 22, has lived with this chronic pain since February. She graduated university with a teaching degree just before the genocide began in October 2023, and has never had the chance to work. The family lives on aid. They were displaced from their home in Jabaliya more than five times before reaching Deir al-Balah in May 2024.
This past May, three months after the pain in her tooth first began, she went to one of the few dentists still working in the area. The decay had reached the nerve, the dentist told her, and the tooth needed root canal treatment, or she would lose it. It would cost 300 shekels (about $100). She told him she couldn't afford to pay it. The dentist said the only other option was to remove the tooth for 50 shekels (about $16).
"I can't pay 300 shekels, and if I have them, it would go to things that matter more," Abo Shamala told Drop Site News. "I'm a girl. Imagine me without a front tooth. How would I laugh or talk to people?" She also knew she wouldn't be able to have the pulled tooth replaced any time soon. The dentist warned her that the infection would worsen, and that the tooth was eroding from the inside and could break at any moment.
The waiting has cost her. Months of painkillers left her with an inflamed stomach, diagnosed at a UNRWA clinic. She can no longer bite into bread or fruit, and cuts her food into small pieces to chew on her back teeth. "If the treatment was 80 shekels the way it used to be, I wouldn't have waited a single day," Abo Shamala said. Seven months on, her tooth is still salvageable but she is still waiting for the price for root canal treatment to come down.
Over the past three years, proper dental care in Gaza has been all but destroyed, along with the rest of the enclave's health care system, devastated by sustained targeted attacks by the Israeli military and a crippling siege that includes vital medical supplies.
Israeli airstrikes have destroyed 80 percent of the dental clinics in Gaza, completely or partially, and more than 100 dentists have been killed since the genocide began, according to Irfan Eshtaiwi, the head of the dentists' syndicate in Gaza's southern governorates. The syndicate receives daily notices from dentists who are shutting down or scaling back to emergency care only. Beyond the blocked supplies, the clinics that remain are working without reliable electricity, running water, or sterilization materials.
Another patient with dental issues faced the same difficult choice as Abo Shamala but made a different decision.
Ahmed Abo Dan, 34, sells chocolate from a small street stand in Deir-al-Balah. He was displaced from his home in northern Gaza in October 2023, after the Israeli military issued sweeping displacement orders for the 1.1 million Palestinians living north of Wadi Gaza to move to the south. In March, Abo Dan began suffering from pain in his tooth. Painkillers were largely unavailable at the local government clinic, and he often could not afford to buy them himself, forcing him to endure the constant ache.
When he finally saw a dentist in June 2026, he was given two options for his molar: a root canal treatment for 450 shekels (around $145), or extraction for 30 shekels (around $10). "I'm displaced and can barely scrape together the price of a bag of bread for my children," Abo Dan told Drop Site. He chose extraction, and borrowed the 30 shekels from a friend to pay for the procedure. The tooth was pulled in July.
"War has made us pull out our teeth just to live," he said. Another tooth has started to hurt him. "I'm afraid to go and be told I need treatment I can't pay for all over again and maybe lose another tooth."
Hardly any dental supplies have entered Gaza since October 2023, according to both Eshtaiwi and Dr. Osama Jaber Al-Shanti, the former dean of the Faculty of Dentistry at the University of Palestine. Last month, Al-Shanti took part in a demonstration by dozens of dentists who gathered in their white coats outside the headquarters of the International Committee of the Red Cross in western Gaza City to demand the entry of dental supplies into Gaza. The siege has continued in violation of a "ceasefire" that went into effect over a year ago.
"They claim these are dual-use materials," Al-Shanti told Drop Site. "It's a label used to evade and restrict, to keep useful materials out of Gaza." Small quantities do get in, he said, through a limited number of private traders who pay very high fees to bring them through, and those black market costs are then built into the price of services offered by clinics.
Before the genocide, a syringe of resin used for fillings that cost 70 to 80 shekels (around $23-26), now costs 1,200 shekels (around $388), according to Al-Shanti, an increase of 1,500%. Root canal treatment, which cost 70 to 150 shekels before the genocide, now runs 500 to 700 shekels at most clinics, Al-Shanti said. He charges 300, because he is still working through inventory he purchased earlier at a lower price and in bulk. The 300 does not cover his costs, yet he maintains the price to avoid turning away patients.
At Al-Shanti's clinic in the Rimal neighborhood of Gaza City earlier this month, three people sat waiting--a mother with her young son and a man resting his cheek in his hand. It's the third clinic Al-Shanti has had to set up from scratch since October 2023, after Israel destroyed two of his previous clinics in strikes and displacement forced him to abandon another.
The clinic has none of the sharp anesthetic smell that usually permeates dental offices. In the treatment room, a scratched yellow chair with a rusted base stood against freshly painted walls, fitted with a new control board and basin. The chair is the only piece of equipment that survived his second clinic, bombed in early 2024. He pulled it from the rubble with a ruined control board and a broken basin. A technician managed to repair the chair by fitting parts from a chair destroyed in another Israeli strike. The repairs cost Al-Shanti more than a new unit would have with spare parts also skyrocketing in price, but he had no choice with no new dental equipment being allowed into Gaza.

---|---|---
A repaired dentist chair at the clinic of Dr. Osama Jaber Al-Shanti in Al-Rimal, Gaza City. October 2026. Photo by Mohanad El-Hemrawi.
At his clinic, Al-Shanti is still able to provide fillings, extractions and root canals. However he has been forced to stop implants, whitening, bridges, and dentures due to a lack of supplies. He said his was one of the few dental clinics still operational. Most of his colleagues have stopped working altogether.
Ayman al-Shabrawi, who owns a dental laboratory in the Al-Saha area of Gaza City, told Drop Site he has closed part of it and laid off two thirds of his staff, and expects to shut the rest if medical supplies continue to be blocked.
The Gaza Center for Human Rights said in August that Israel bars a wide range of purely therapeutic dental materials and equipment under the dual-use label, and that the resulting prices have pushed dentists toward tooth extraction as the only remaining option. In Khan Younis governorate, the center said, only one government dental clinic and two UNRWA clinics are still operating, alongside a small number of private practices.
In March 2025, Al-Shanti screened children in displacement camps in Deir al-Balah and Khan Younis for a Save the Children Netherlands program, which also carried out medical screening for orphans. He found large numbers of children with untreated decay that no one was following up on, and whose families could not take them to a dentist. Malnutrition, he said, has made it worse. Most of the children in Gaza are not examined at all, he said.
Warda Shaath, a dentist in Khan Yunis, said most dental treatment has to be rationed because supplies are simply not available. Light-cured fillings, for example, have disappeared from the market, she said. Some procedures that cost around 50 shekels (around $16) before the genocide now cost close to 250 shekels (around $81).
About 90 percent of her patients now ask to have the tooth pulled rather than to receive treatment, she said, because they cannot pay for a filling or a root canal. If the supply shortage continues, she is considering closing down the clinic next month.
Shaath still does implants, with materials she buys on the black market at very high prices. One of her patients, a 32-year-old mother of four, lost several teeth when her house collapsed on her. She needs four implants. The full treatment would cost around 10,000 shekels (around $3,300), and the first stage alone would cost close to 5,000 shekels (around $1,615). Shaath said the clinic tried to find a way to cover the costs but they were unable to, and the woman left in tears.
Dentists say they want to help their patients but are left without any options with the ongoing Israeli siege.
"The moment supplies enter, the first thing I will do is message all my patients and drop my prices immediately," Al-Shanti said. The profession has a human side, he said, and is not only about profit.
Back in her tent, Nour Abo Shamala's front tooth is growing weaker and darker. A small piece broke off the edge of the tooth recently when she bit down on a piece of dry bread. She is still waiting for Israel to allow supplies to come in, so the prices can come down.

"The guy ICE was trying to grab was a criminal! Someone who wasn't good for their community. (The protesters) should apologize!" Mateo sounded off on Piker, referring to a recent ICE-involved shooting in New York City and subsequent protests.
"Two guys stabbed a police officer seven times last week! Two undocumented Dominican kids were arrested. These kids were not good people!" Mateo continued.

# _**Is she drunk?**_**Indiana democrat 's very weird interview goes viral**
Jaime West, a Democratic candidate for Fayette County council, drew widespread online attention after a **[rambling, slurred televised forum appearance](https://substack.com/redirect/07322361-b6e9-49dc-ac20-ff5c6da99380?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** in which she admitted being unprepared, vowed to "fire all Republicans," and claimed "we have guns too" directly to camera.
## [Watch here:](https://substack.com/redirect/07322361-b6e9-49dc-ac20-ff5c6da99380?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
[](https://substack.com/redirect/07322361-b6e9-49dc-ac20-ff5c6da99380?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
* **The clip, viewed millions of times after TV3 posted it,** shows West criticizing MAGA supporters as "racist" and unintelligent, while also claiming a sheriff's relative once threatened her, prompting widespread mockery online with many questioning whether the video was staged.
* **West has not publicly responded to the viral attention.** She faces Republican Gary Jeener Jr. in the county council race, with voting scheduled for Nov. 3 alongside the broader midterm elections.

[Click To Watch Video](https://substack.com/redirect/07322361-b6e9-49dc-ac20-ff5c6da99380?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)

# **Washington girls walk off cross-country race over transgender competitor**
About a dozen Camas High School runners **[walked off the starting line Tuesday](https://substack.com/redirect/2f50843c-6f4d-4e84-bfcd-d80628e037d1?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** rather than compete against a transgender athlete who had started the season on the boys' team, sparking viral attention to Washington's ongoing eligibility debate.
[| | | | | Brandi Kruse
---
@BrandiKruse
BREAKING: Nearly half of the girls cross-country team in Camas, Washington, just forfeited their race. They refused to compete against a boy. This is bravery. Vote YES on I-638 to stand with them. Video: @KnownHeretic
| 12:06 AM * Oct 14, 2026 * 2.59M Views1.85K Replies * 8.54K Reposts * 74K Likes

* **One athlete 's parents said their daughter initially hesitated to protest but joined after teammates rallied together;** they also clashed with event security over holding protest signs and faced confrontations from at least one bystander critical of their stance.
* **The dispute coincides with Washington 's Initiative 638,** a Nov. 3 ballot measure that would restrict female-only competitions to biological females, though it wouldn't take effect before the state's Nov. 7 championships. A separate Washington case involving a similar dispute remains pending before the Supreme Court.

# **Jack Smith probe gathered data on MAGA hat buyers**
A newly released memo from Senate Judiciary Chair Chuck Grassley shows former Special Counsel Jack Smith's investigation **[collected personal data](https://substack.com/redirect/153b59c9-befa-4e26-ace1-22964b22b193?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** -- including names, addresses, and voter registrations -- on at least 639,000 Republican donors, voters, and supporters, with records dating back to 2005.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/153b59c9-befa-4e26-ace1-22964b22b193?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **The data collection reportedly included shipping addresses of people who bought MAGA merchandise,** fueling Grassley's claim that Smith's team sought to map the broader Republican Party apparatus rather than pursue a narrowly scoped investigation.
* **The findings add to prior disclosures showing Smith 's team monitored communications involving the Trump White House,** members of Congress, journalists, and thousands of small-dollar donors, part of the broader "Arctic Frost" probe into the 2020 fake elector scheme. Grassley says Americans' financial and personal information remains in DOJ and FBI possession.

name: Forward Party
subject: South Dakota - $20, 20 days!
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Forward Party and not authorized by any candidate or candidate's committee
body:
With 20 days remaining, can you help with the final push?

| | | [ ](www.forwardparty.com)
---
Peter, There are 20 days until Election Day. In South Dakota, roughly a quarter of registered voters are independents, and almost no one is talking to them. We are here to change that, and we need your help to finish strong! **Will you pitch in $20 today (one dollar for every day left until Election Day)?** [](https://home.forwardparty.com/donate?e=61868e7acdd36ae0ddf3e39aa8429171&utm_source=forwardparty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=south_dakota_20_and_20&n=1) As you may have seen, Forward has teamed up with the nonprofit Moving America Forward to reach independent voters in key states across the country. We just wrapped up an amazing weekend knocking on doors in Boise, Idaho - _see photos below!_ **Next stop: South Dakota, where early voting is already underway!** Earlier this month, our teams made more than 100,000 voter contacts there in a single weekend, and now we’re heading back to make sure independents know they can vote now. Any and all support gets our team there and talking to voters! [](https://home.forwardparty.com/donate?e=61868e7acdd36ae0ddf3e39aa8429171&utm_source=forwardparty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=south_dakota_20_and_20&n=2) **Here’s why South Dakota is such a big deal:** historically, the Republican and Democratic parties organize their own voters. Independents (one of the largest blocs in the state) have been left almost entirely on their own, with no outreach and not even a reminder about when and where to vote. The window to reach them is closing fast. **Will you pitch in to help us reach independent voters in South Dakota?** [](https://home.forwardparty.com/donate?e=61868e7acdd36ae0ddf3e39aa8429171&utm_source=forwardparty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=south_dakota_20_and_20&n=3) If you’ve contributed already and/or would like to volunteer, come to Sioux Falls, SD on October 24 and 25! No experience needed. We’ll train you, pair you with a team, and send you out with everything you need. **Sign up to canvass with us by simply replying to this e-mail!** When no one else shows up for independent voters, we WILL. Thank you for considering a contribution, canvassing, or both, and thank you for believing we can do better. In action and optimism, Monika
---

body:
Judicial Watch announced today that it filed a Michigan Freedom of
Information Act (FOIA) lawsuit against the City of Detroit for records
documenting the number of dogs and cats euthanized by Detroit Animal
Care and Control when then-Detroit Health Director Abdul El-Sayed
oversaw the city agency (Judicial Watch, Inc. v. City of Detroit (No.
26-018170)). The request also seeks records about euthanized animals
after El-Sayed’s tenure for comparison purposes.

subject: Immediate Impact Fund update

body:
These 12 races could use support this week.
#
Hi there,
Elon Musk is pouring an extraordinary amount of money into the 2026 elections to help Republicans hold onto power.
Since the start of July, Musk has spent more than $276 million to boost Republican candidates and groups, including a staggering $158 million to the Senate Leadership Fund, Republicans’ top super PAC for Senate races. That brings his total political giving this cycle to at least $366 million—more than he spent during the entire 2024 election.
And Musk isn’t alone. Republican campaigns, committees, and allied groups have outspent Democrats by about $400 million so far this election cycle.
**That’s why we’ve just updated the Immediate Impact Fund to include the 12 races where grassroots donations can make the biggest difference this week.[If that’s all you need to hear, you can click here to donate now.](https://act.swingleft.org/go/2669?t=1&akid=3143%2E1562180%2E0W3wkf)**
You’ll notice that several races from our last slate are still on the list. That’s because in our discussions with candidates and officials across the country, we’ve determined these are still among the closest races, and they still need more resources to keep up with their Republican opponents.
Here’s a look at some of the races in the fund this week, where Republican super donors are pouring money to maintain Trump’s hand on the balance of power:
**A Must-Flip House Race**
**Jessica Killin, Colorado’s 5th District:** Democrat Jessica Killin is a veteran and former Hill staffer. In July, a poll showed her just 1 point behind first-term Republican Rep. Jeff Crank. Since then, Trump’s super PAC has spent $1.9 million attacking her, and she needs our support to fight back.
**A Must-Flip Senate Race**
**Josh Turek, Iowa:** Democratic State Representative Josh Turek is a Paralympian who has already won in a Trump district. Polls show a very close race, but Republican outside groups have spent more than $39 million attacking him since October 1st. He needs the financial support to talk to voters in every corner of the state.
**A Must-Hold Governor’s Race**
**Katie Hobbs, Arizona:** Democratic Governor Katie Hobbs is in a tightening re-election race against extreme MAGA Representative Andy Biggs, and Turning Point USA is spending $18 million in support of Biggs. Polls show Hobbs’ lead in the single digits, so she needs our support to fight back against all the GOP spending against her.
Many of the districts and states on this week’s list will also be critically important to winning in 2028 and beyond. That means your donation helps win this November and builds the infrastructure Democrats will need to win in the future.
[**With less than 3 weeks left until Election Day, will you support these candidates by making a donation to the Immediate Impact Fund today?**](https://act.swingleft.org/go/2669?t=2&akid=3143%2E1562180%2E0W3wkf)
**[Donate Now](https://act.swingleft.org/go/2669?t=3&akid=3143%2E1562180%2E0W3wkf)**
Thank you, as always, for everything you’re doing to help Democrats win.
— The Swing Left Team

**Since 2017, Swing Left has channeled the energy of grassroots volunteers and donors to elect Democrats, up and down the ballot, focusing on the most competitive races that can swing the national balance of power.** Right now, Swing Left is investing in grassroots organizing in key swing districts and initiatives across the country to flip the House and win the Senate and critical states in 2026. [**If you’d like to help support our work, you can make a donation using this link.**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em_ms_sl_footer?refcode=em20261014-2&t=4&refcode2=3143_1562180_0W3wkf&akid=3143%2E1562180%2E0W3wkf)

When I got into this race, I had a 4% chance of winning the primary. There were more than 20 candidates in the field, and one of them had spent over 20 years building his name inside the establishment. Plenty of people had already decided how this would end._You/Our supporters didn 't listen to them._ You/they helped us gather more than **28,000** signatures to get us on the primary election ballot. You/they helped raise nearly **$3 million** in the primary alone, more than ten times what my opponents raised.And even though it took days to call the race after the June 30th election, we eventually were declared the winner -- proving everyone else wrong. I'm telling you this because I want you to see what I see right now. **We can flip a deep blue state in one election, and I want to show you exactly how.** Nearly half of Colorado's unaffiliated voters are already with us. Only 15% say they won't vote for me. The other 38% haven't made up their minds. **To win, I need 58% of those unaffiliated voters.** Our numbers put us at 46% today.So the governor's office comes down to about 12 points, and the people behind those points are still listening. Here's what we need you to know right now:

**When we say this is one of the most vulnerable Blue seats in the country, we really mean it. In fact, it's one of the only Democrat held toss-ups left in the country.** I'm one of just a handful of Democrats who represent districts that Trump won in 2024, and in the last election, our MAGA opponent came within a _**fraction of a percentage point**_ of beating us.

**And it's no secret that this district is once again a top MAGA target.** Last October, the Ohio GOP redrew our map with the explicit goal of gerrymandering me out of Congress.

**This race is bigger than just Northwest Ohio.** Dark money groups spent a staggering _**$25 million**_ trying to buy this seat in 2024, because I've never stopped fighting for policies that put working people first.

Folks, it’s James Carville.

I’ve spent nearly half a century helping Democrats win elections, and I’m gonna tell you something plainly:

**For too long, we have waited until the house was already on fire before deciding to buy a hose.**

We wait until a race becomes a crisis.

We wait until a great candidate is getting buried in attack ads.

We wait until Republicans have already built the infrastructure, raised the money, and defined the battlefield.

Then everybody starts running around asking what happened.

Well, Raja Krishnamoorthi has gone and done something about it.

He founded [**Equal Opportunity Now**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/141430967/653523817/1090555623?refcode=261014_carville_resend&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDUvMS83MzE2OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJjNjAxYjRiNS0xY2M4LWYxMTEtYmY1Yi0wMDBkM2E0ZmJlODMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=j0jC_CfIgE6CwIywDVToRDkaLu74OlDQMsE7ouqOYCE=) to find and support bold leaders and important causes before it’s too late — leaders who will stand up to Donald Trump and the MAGA movement, fight for working families, and actually deliver results.

And all I can say is:

**FINALLY.**

Finally, an organization that understands we cannot defeat MAGA with timid candidates, stale talking points, and a last-minute panic.

But Raja cannot build this by himself.

[**Will you contribute $25, $50, or whatever you can today to help Equal Opportunity Now find, fund, and support the leaders Democrats need to start winning again?**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/141430968/653523818/1090555623?refcode=261014_carville_resend&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDUvMS83MzE2OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJjNjAxYjRiNS0xY2M4LWYxMTEtYmY1Yi0wMDBkM2E0ZmJlODMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=j0jC_CfIgE6CwIywDVToRDkaLu74OlDQMsE7ouqOYCE=)

Now, I know Raja.
He is smart. He is tough. And he knows firsthand what opportunity can mean.
His family came to this country with very little. They relied on public housing and food stamps. He worked his way from Peoria all the way to Congress.
And instead of pulling the ladder up behind him, Raja has spent his career fighting to make sure the next family gets the same shot.
That means standing up for workers.
Holding powerful corporations and corrupt politicians accountable.
Defending immigrants, voting rights, and every American targeted by Trump’s politics of division.
And now he is putting that experience toward building the next generation of Democratic leadership.
**Here’s the truth: The leaders we need are already out there.**
They are running for city council, state legislature, Congress, and offices most national donors are not paying attention to yet.
They have the courage.
They have the ideas.
What they do not always have is the money, infrastructure, and early support necessary to compete.
That is where Equal Opportunity Now comes in.

Voters deserve answers. | = Team — Arizona’s State Treasurer manages billions of dollars that belong to every Arizonan — including investments that help fund our public schools. That office should serve Arizona, not Donald Trump. But Elijah Norton already told us whose side he's on. He branded himself “Trump’s Treasurer.” He said he would run the Treasurer’s Office the way Donald Trump runs Washington. Now, with Trump set to rally in Bullhead City, Arizona voters deserve a straight answer: Is Norton running for Treasurer of Arizona, or Treasurer of MAGA? Democrat Nick Mansour has a different answer. He’ll judge state investments on their returns, not their politics. Arizonans are tired of leaders who treat public office like a loyalty test. Normally when you see my name in your inbox, I like the messages to be different from the other emails you get from most elected officials.
I've written to you in detail about the depth of corruption and self-enrichment of the Trump Administration, the President's thirst for political retribution and intimidation, along with other things I am seeing or working on in Washington, D.C. and at home in Georgia.
This message is different. It's more direct.
I am reaching out today with a last-ditch request for a contribution to my campaign before our FEC fundraising drive comes to a close tonight at midnight. Here's why:
This race will be one of the most competitive and expensive in the nation. I am the only Democratic Senator up for reelection in a state Trump won in 2024 and that makes me MAGA's #1 target.
In 2020, the pundits said flipping a Republican Senate seat in Georgia couldn't be done. But we built one of the strongest voter mobilization programs in Senate campaign history -- and we won. That victory won the Senate majority.
Now we must win again. And we will win again.
Just like last time, I can't do it alone.
So I'm asking:
**[Please make a contribution to my reelection campaign before our final FEC fundraising deadline at midnight.](https://substack.com/redirect/d0f85dfe-d6c8-4914-85db-088bd4d6f1f1?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**

The average online donation to our campaign is around $30. Many give less. Some give more.
All that matters is that lots and lots of people are contributing what they can before our deadline. **[Please, contribute today.](https://substack.com/redirect/d0f85dfe-d6c8-4914-85db-088bd4d6f1f1?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**

I've been on the road a lot recently, pressed for time, hopping from one city to the next, but I still wanted to take some time out of my day to write to you.I didn't waste time sending this to my team for final review; I wanted to get this over to you as soon as I possibly could. If you've been following what's happening in Minnesota, here's where we're at now: 1. The latest polls now have me and my Far Left opponent, Peggy Flanagan, DEAD EVEN in the home stretch. Voters are clearly demanding change. 2. My campaign has been surging past our expectations thanks to thousands of grassroots patriots like you chipping in just $5 or $10 whenever they can (contrary to my socialist opponent's wealthy boosters). 3. The Democrat political machine has invested thousands in bogus attack ads in Minnesota against me because they're terrified of us pulling off the upset. It's clear now, more than ever, that the tides are turning in our direction. I wanted to show you, in these points above, some of the fruits of all of our hard work together. But the final buzzer still hasn 't sounded, and you don't get a prize for winning the 3rd quarter when there's plenty of time left in the game! I've seen first-hand PLENTY of teams who think they've got the win in the bag take their foot off the gas and go on defense... all to face defeat right before the clock hits zero. We won 't be that team. If anything, we're itching to snatch victory from the jaws of defeat. We've known since the start of this movement that we're the clear underdog in this race. But we're FAR from throwing in the towel. Now that we're in the home stretch, your direct support to me and this movement becomes even more important. Truth be told, it'd be a disaster if we lost you, Fellow American. Your critical donation today will help power this campaign through our most critical stretch. I can't thank you enough for your continued support. Michele TafoyaRepublican Nominee for Senate, Minnesota It's official - Michele Tafoya is running for U.S. Senate in Minnesota! My name is Victor Marx -- a husband, father, Marine Corps veteran, former pastor, and founder of an international humanitarian organization that has carried out more than 150 high-risk rescue missions around the world.I've spent my life stepping into the chaos most people run from, fighting for those who can't fight for themselves. I never expected to run for Governor of Colorado... But people I respected deeply -- including Charlie and Erika Kirk -- believed in me and urged me to step forward because they saw what was happening here in our state.After Charlie was killed, Erika reminded me that he believed this was a fight I was meant to take on.They were right, and I am now fully committed to winning this fight. Because here's the truth most people outside our state don't realize: Colorado SHOULD still be a red state. Colorado was built on independence, limited government, faith, family, and the unshakeable belief in the Second Amendment. Those values run deep in our history and in our people.But over time, the political establishment and a flood of left-wing ideas have overpowered the very values that made Colorado strong. We've watched our state shift from red, to purple, to blue -- not because the people changed, but because leadership failed them.And that failure matters far beyond our borders. Colorado has become a testing ground for policies that spread nationwide -- soft-on-crime agendas, government overreach, attacks on faith, restrictions on constitutional freedoms. If we stop that tide here, we stop it from sweeping across America. That's why this race is so important. If Colorado flips back, the entire country will feel it. It will prove that conservative, constitutional values aren't fading -- they 're rising again! Our state and country has too many politicians , so instead, I'm asking you to stand with ME - a Marine, pastor, humanitarian, and Patriot - to ensure we have leaders who will fight to uphold and protect our values and freedoms. This is our chance to send that message. This is our chance to restore a state that should never have been lost.And this is the moment every patriot -- in Colorado and across America -- should care about. If you're just learning about me today, I hope it's the beginning of something bigger. Because this movement isn't powered by mega-donors or coastal elites -- Thank you for standing with me! body:
Take action with young people across the country while honoring our ancestors and building a community altar. | | | Peter, Students from 15 schools across the East Coast recently came together at our People Powered East Convening to plan their Powered by Students campaigns. 💪🏽 Powered by Students is our campaign to make sure college is for all of us, no matter our immigration status. From protecting in-state tuition to building safe campuses, students across the country are taking action to build the schools they need. At the convening, students learned how to identify their people and the change their campuses need, how to build a campaign plan and timeline, and how to craft tactics that actually win. Now they’re heading back to their schools to build the future we deserve. 🧡 This is what community power is about, when we come together, learn from each other, and commit to action, we make change happen. clean_body: Take action with young people across the country while honoring our ancestors and building a community altar. | | | Peter, Students from 15 schools across the East Coast recently came together at our People Powered East Convening to plan their Powered by Students campaigns. 💪🏽 Powered by Students is our campaign to make sure college is for all of us, no matter our immigration status. From protecting in-state tuition to building safe campuses, students across the country are taking action to build the schools they need. At the convening, students learned how to identify their people and the change their campuses need, how to build a campaign plan and timeline, and how to craft tactics that actually win. Now they’re heading back to their schools to build the future we deserve. 🧡 This is what community power is about, when we come together, learn from each other, and commit to action, we make change happen. If you’re ready to join young people around the country who are doing just that, join us for on Wednesday, October 21 at 7PM ET! The power students are building today is rooted in the generations of organizers that came before them. On this call, we’ll not only honor our ancestors and the people in our communities who have lost their lives at the hands of federal agents, we’ll also be building a community altar using the tradition of Dia de Los Muertos. 🕯️ Don’t forget to bring a photo of a loved one, a beloved pet, or someone from your community to add to our digital ofrenda. 🏵️ – Ximena and the rest of the UWD Team | Follow us on: | | | | |
